notes.subject: the verse
notes.rationale: Ditekanyo tsa Debire: mashome a mabedi a ama ka ditho tse tharo — bolelele, bophara, bolele.

notes.subject: e kentsweng
notes.rationale: סגור e bolela 'e tletseng' (shut up); 'gauta e kentsweng' ke gauta e hloekisitsweng, phetolelo ya moelelo eseng ya tlhaku.

notes.subject: altare ya sedare
notes.rationale: מזבח ארז: KJV 'the altar which was of cedar' vs JPS 'he set an altar... covered with cedar' — hore na altare e entsoe ka sedare kapa e apetswe ka sedare.

notes.subject: ויצפהו
notes.rationale: Sehlahiso 'o' — a e apesa — se bontsha hore se apesilweng ke Debire, se sa bontshwang ka ho hlakileng ka Sesotho ntle le ponelopele.

translation: Mme ka pele ga Debire: mashome a mabedi a ama bolelele, mme mashome a mabedi a ama bophara, mme mashome a mabedi a ama bolele ba yona; mme a e apesa ka gauta e kentsweng, mme a apesa altare ya sedare.
